subject: session date
fact: The events occur on Planting 22, 579.
source_quote: Planting 22, 579

subject: session date
fact: The events continue on Planting 23, 579.
source_quote: Planting 23, 579

subject: Honey Tavern Inn
fact: Zinnia arrives at the Honey Tavern Inn after the dinner rush.
source_quote: I arrive at the Honey Tavern Inn. It’s after the dinner rush

subject: barrel
fact: Zinnia carries a barrel to the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: With the barrel over my shoulder I arrive at the Honey Tavern Inn.

subject: keg of mead
fact: Glannon gives Zinnia a keg of mead with magical properties.
source_quote: Here’s my fine keg of mead.

subject: keg of mead
fact: The magic in the mead helps with persuasion and attracting attention.
source_quote: The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.

subject: Glannon
fact: Glannon rolls the barrel behind the bar.
source_quote: He rolls the barrel behind the bar

subject: Quinna Poul
fact: Quinna Poul rushes out of the kitchen when Sequoia enters the dining area.
source_quote: Quinna Poul comes rushing out of the kitchen as I saunter into the first floor dining area.

subject: animated ingredients flee
fact: Some ingredients from the feast became animated and rushed into the village.
source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village

subject: broccoli animated
fact: An animated broccoli ran toward the apothecary shop.
source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary

subject: broccoli destroyed
fact: Sequoia shot the animated broccoli, causing it to collapse.
source_quote: I roll, and I can’t remember if I hit, but yes, I do and it just kind of collapses.

subject: dark green substance
fact: The collapsed broccoli became a very dark green something.
source_quote: I pick up the “broccoli” now just a very dark green something

subject: potatoes animated
fact: Animated potatoes were bouncing around the village.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes

subject: potato stabbed
fact: Zephyr stabbed one animated potato with his knife.
source_quote: I take my knife and stab the one in my hand.

subject: potatoes captured
fact: Zephyr captured two other animated potatoes in a bag.
source_quote: I grab them and stuff them into a bag.

subject: potato consumed
fact: Zephyr ate one of the captured potatoes.
source_quote: a few hours later, the potato is in my belly.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee coughs while sitting quietly in the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: Palsmarie Clee coughs. The beekeeper druid of Sheernobb is very quiet.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee shows Zephyr a map indicating where the caravan was attacked.
source_quote: Let me show you on the map where the caravan was.

subject: caravan attacked
fact: The caravan was attacked and did not take the standard road.
source_quote: They didn’t take the standard road, the fools.

subject: Black Earth Cult
fact: The attackers of the caravan chanted 'Black Earth' and carried stone weapons.
source_quote: the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone.

subject: Gnonsbim
fact: Gnonsbim claims the attackers were bandits.
source_quote: Gnonsbim says they are bandits.

subject: Kron Hills
fact: The trail from the caravan attack leads into the Kron Hills.
source_quote: The trail into the Kron Hills is easy to follow.

subject: falling rocks
fact: The party almost got crushed by falling rocks while following the trail.
source_quote: we almost get crushed by falling rocks.

subject: hidden encampment
fact: A hidden encampment is built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills.
source_quote: it ends at a well-hidden encampment. It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills.

subject: hidden encampment
fact: The hidden encampment has a guarded gate with makeshift stone barricades.
source_quote: There is a guarded gate with makeshift stone barricades.

subject: stone-studded leather armor wearers
fact: Guardians at the encampment wear stone-studded leather armor and carry stone weapons.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: hidden encampment
fact: The encampment contains a temple with a weird stone statue and the stolen honey barrels.
source_quote: Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is a druid who leads the encampment and speaks of the Earth Mother.
source_quote: This Thalsor of the Stone fellow, some kind of druid, starts shouting about the earth mother

subject: Thalsor confronts Calmer
fact: Thalsor accuses Calmer of trespassing on sacred ground and calls the party fools and thieves.
source_quote: You think yourselves heroes? … You, who scurry above the earth like witless insects … unworthy of the honey you dare to steal back.

subject: mud men summoned
fact: Thalsor summoned two muddy creatures called mud men beside Calmer.
source_quote: suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men.

subject: mud men
fact: Mud men explode when defeated, creating an area that impedes movement.
source_quote: when these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: stone golem
fact: Thalsor summoned a stone golem that is resistant to non-magical attacks.
source_quote: he taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: stone golem damaged
fact: Calmer's holy spell dealt significant damage to the stone golem.
source_quote: Calmer hits it with some kind of holy spell, deals a ton of damage

subject: Thalsor negotiates
fact: Thalsor attempts to negotiate with the party instead of continuing to fight.
source_quote: Thalsor isn't happy at all, though. He starts ranting again about the honey and the earth, then suddenly shifts gears and tries to negotiate.

subject: stone storm conjured
fact: Thalsor conjured a storm of sharp stones during the battle.
source_quote: he conjures up a storm of sharp stones.

subject: Black Earth Cult's identity
fact: The party suspects the Black Earth Cult is responsible for the caravan attack and may possess the box Lareth wants.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia shows a momentary flash of pleasure upon hearing about the Black Earth Cult.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.
